evidence.note: Eyebrow '01 · OUTPUT' and the 'Output' chip use a darker olive accent-ink for accent-coloured text.
The 71% hero figure is set in the bright lime accent colour itself.
The caption 'Share of weekday daytime electricity...' is body text in the same bright lime accent, not the darker ink.
Same: figure and caption both in bright lime accent; eyebrow and chip in darker accent-ink.

rationale: The deck has a darker accent-ink token for accent-coloured text (eyebrow, chip), yet the bright accent itself is used as text for the figure and, decoratively, for a plain caption. The caption carries no focus role, so the accent is applied outside its declared role, matching the fail descriptor.
